scope: matched two-level system/LRU and three-level system/LRU/SRU local physical replacement and repeated reissue

preceding_unpublished_diagnostic.result: one nested repair, no repeated demand; failed frozen repetition gate

source.boundary: System-to-LRU is the accepted two-level physical chain. Adding one SRU under the LRU creates the three-level material hierarchy. Aircraft-level LRU removal/fit, LRU-level SRU replacement, and SRU direct repair are distinct. A matching ItemReplacement row overrides general ItemRepair SURP time. Matching System, LRU and SRU FRT values leave no residual direct parent failure.

delta: Raise System and LRU traditional FRT in accepted E05 from 450000 to 1200000 per million OPHOURS in the two-level arm. Raise System, LRU and SRU FRT in accepted G01 from 300000 to 1200000 in the three-level arm. Only rates and descriptions change within each parent. Across arms, Control, System, mission schedule, seed, horizon and aircraft-level repair are identical; six tables differ because adding the SRU level requires Item, ItemStructure, ItemRepair, ItemReplacement and StockAllocation rows plus description. Do not infer matched event times or a one-field causal effect across changed material topology and RNG sequence.
pre_run_hypotheses: Two-level and three-level arms each import/export exactly their 20 and 21 populated authored tables, convert with zero errors and produce nonempty valid SXI/SXO, events and 72-bin reports.

The increased fixed exposure should produce at least two installed LRU failures and two aircraft-level LRU demands in each arm. A single failure or no repaired LRU reissue in either arm is a diagnostic NO-GO; exact failure times and count are observed, not prescribed.
In the two-level arm, each removed LRU enters direct item repair without SRU demand. At least one repaired physical LRU returns to local stock and is issued for a later aircraft-level demand.

In the three-level arm, each removed LRU reveals a nested failed SRU, consumes a local SRU replacement, completes its item-specific 0.75-hour SURP rather than 1.5-hour general SURP, and returns to LRU stock. Each removed SRU undergoes one-hour direct repair and returns to SRU stock. At least one repaired physical LRU is reissued for a later aircraft-level demand.

For every observed cycle, reconcile physical LRU/SRU identities, inventory and backorder levels, task resource requests, mission outcome, ready state, System/Stock report metrics and terminal state. Compare topology and distinct repair/stock ledgers across arms without attributing different stochastic times to structure alone.
decision_rule: Accept the bounded F01.var01 two/three-level comparison only if both arms satisfy the repeated reissue and all individual ledgers, native steps, source/raw hashes, exact diffs and every report interval are independently replayed read-only. If either arm misses the required geometry or another gate, retain the pair as sealed diagnostic evidence and design a fresh version; do not relax acceptance after seeing output.
limits: One system, one LRU and optionally one SRU, one base, local stock and repair, seed 1, 36-hour horizon; no ASSY, more than three physical levels, extra repair locations, resource scarcity, PM, transport or explicit failure-mode CM.
This bounded run does not close known issue #403's general nested replacement boundary.
GUI-only presentation and cross-engine equivalence are unverified.
